verdict.rationale: Steel's core browser API is published as open source (steel-browser on GitHub) and ships a pre-built Docker image combining the API and UI. It also exposes CDP control for Puppeteer, Playwright and Selenium, so a user can run the core product on their own infrastructure. Community commenters likewise describe it as an open-source Browserbase alternative. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting docs (deployment, configuration, scaling), clarity on whether cloud features like CAPTCHA solving, managed proxies and agent traces work when self-hosted, and independent hands-on reports of a self-hosted deployment.
